title: QoS panel per-direction depth row overflows the 300px panel plate onto the map
evidence: app/qos_panel.odin:36: `QOS_PANEL_W :: 300` (plate right edge = QOS_PANEL_X 12 + 300 = 312). The new loop at 409-422: `for dir in 0..<pp.PORT_DIR_COUNT {` / `draw_text(app, dirs[dir], qdx, qd_y + 3, 14, p.ink_soft_text)` / `qdx += 30` / (3 cells) `qdx += 34` / `qdx += 10` — per direction 30+3x34+10 = 142, two directions = 284, plus the measured label `depth_label := fmt.tprintf("queue depth (bound %d):", bound)` (~140-160px at 14px) + 8 → row spans ~432-452px from x=22; the "rev" block starts at ~322 > 312. draw path is unclipped: app/render/view.odin:1441 `rl.DrawTextEx(f, cstring(raw_data(cbuf)), {f32(x), f32(y)}, f32(size), 1, col)`. The removed single-direction row (~267px) fit inside 300.
detail: S5 bounds render edits to "Minimal mechanical render edits for compile/read correctness ONLY" — the re-keyed row no longer fits its panel: the "rev" block draws ~130-150px past the plate onto the map, unreadable/overlapping. Goldens never capture the panel open, so the suite cannot see it.
recommended_fix: Stack the two direction blocks on separate sub-rows (fwd line, rev line) or shrink the cell pitch so the row stays within QOS_PANEL_W=300; add a render-test pin asserting the row's right edge <= the panel rect.
